Wire BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors while keeping outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines via extracted wrappers.
Stage and commit both rotation files (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json and legacy inline field) in a single explicit local binding-store commit without git add -A.

Verify idempotent no-absent-key-GET passes leave all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and do not advance HEAD, while passes with absent-key GETs advance rotation stamps in both representations.
Preserve rollback behavior so reverted old binaries ignore the sidecar but see the legacy field advanced by every new-binary pass.
